top_stories.title: Workday to Acquire C1.ai, a Leading Agentic Identity Platform for People and Agents
top_stories.summary: Workday announced its acquisition of C1.ai, described as an agentic identity platform managing access for both human users and AI agents throughout their lifecycle. The deal, announced at Workday Rising 2026, positions Workday to offer integrated identity governance capabilities covering provisioning and deprovisioning for people and AI agents.

top_stories.title: CISA Urges Immediate Ivanti Connect Secure Updates as Honeypots Log 105 Exploit Attempts
top_stories.summary: CISA is urging organizations to immediately update Ivanti Connect Secure appliances following active exploitation of CVE-2026-104935, an authentication bypass vulnerability with a CVSS score of 8.6. Honeypot data has recorded 105 exploit attempts targeting this flaw, which affects the widely-used secure access and VPN platform.

top_stories.title: SAP Discloses Critical CVSS 10 Flaw in Cloud SDK for Python Allowing OAuth2 Credential Theft
top_stories.summary: SAP disclosed a critical CVSS 10 vulnerability in its Cloud SDK for Python that allows OAuth2 client credential theft by redirecting credentials to an attacker-controlled server. The flaw affects multi-tenant applications on SAP Business Technology Platform that use the SDK, requiring an attacker to control the tenant subdomain to exploit it.

top_stories.title: Golden SAML, Explained: One Stolen Key, Unlimited Accepted Identities
top_stories.summary: The article explains the Golden SAML attack technique, which allows attackers to forge SAML tokens using stolen AD FS signing keys to impersonate any identity without detection. It covers the role of the Distributed Key Manager (DKM) container in protecting signing keys and addresses what Microsoft's October hardening measures do and do not mitigate.

top_stories.title: Ivanti ICS Zero-Day Attacks Highlight Vendor Patching Hurdles
top_stories.summary: A high-severity zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-104935) affecting Ivanti ICS combines authentication bypass and remote code execution, and was only partially discovered and patched in July. The incomplete patch left systems exposed, allowing threat actors to exploit the authentication bypass flaw in active attacks.

news.title: Immuta CISO predicts critical AI incidents at major enterprises within 18 months
news.summary: Immuta CISO Michael Scott discusses how organizations should manage permissions for AI agents, arguing they should be treated as lower-trust identities rather than inheriting full user access privileges. The interview covers agent privilege creep, authority delegation to sub-agents, and why authentication alone is insufficient to secure AI agent actions.

news.title: Anthropic 'SneakPeek' Flaw Is a Silent Zero-Click Threat
news.summary: A vulnerability dubbed "SneakPeek" in Anthropic's Claude Code Desktop allows attackers to silently steal credentials including SSH private keys, AWS credentials, and OAuth tokens via the application's preview pane without user interaction. The zero-click flaw enables credential theft from developers without requiring any action on the victim's part.

news.title: CISA warns admins to immediately fix Ivanti flaw exploited as zero-day
news.summary: CISA issued an urgent warning to security teams to immediately patch a zero-day vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure that has been actively exploited since at least October 1st. Ivanti Connect Secure is a widely-used SSL VPN solution that handles remote access and authentication, making this vulnerability directly relevant to access management infrastructure.

news.title: FBI raids 40+ laptop farms helping North Korea pocket US tech salaries
news.summary: The US Department of Justice arrested individuals in Ohio and Texas for helping North Korean IT workers infiltrate over 70 US companies using stolen and fabricated identities to obtain remote employment. The scheme involved Americans operating laptop farms from their homes to maintain access to company systems on behalf of the fraudulent workers.

news.title: Microsoft Disrupts 3 Phishing Kits Linked to Over 1 Billion Scam Messages
news.summary: Microsoft, alongside Health-ISAC, JC3, and private sector partners, disrupted three phishing kits—CoGUI, Haozi, and Iron Man System—linked to over 1 billion scam messages since January 2026. The operation targeted credential-harvesting infrastructure used by threat actors to conduct large-scale phishing campaigns.

news.title: How to Run a Deepfake Readiness Drill Before a Cloned Voice Calls Your Team
news.summary: The article outlines a structured drill methodology for security teams to test their defenses against deepfake voice and video attacks targeting authentication workflows, including help desk resets and access requests. The drill is designed to identify verification gaps in identity confirmation processes before real deepfake-based social engineering attacks occur.

news.title: An AI Agent Found a Critical OTP Bypass in Production. The Attack Was the Easy Part.
news.summary: An AI pentesting agent independently discovered a critical OTP bypass vulnerability during an authorized assessment of a major insurer's production website. The flaw allowed users to redirect one-time passcodes to an attacker-controlled destination by manipulating a parameter in the login request.

news.title: Semperis 2026 Ransomware Report Reveals Increases in AI-Driven Attacks and a Rise in Physical Threats Against Executives and Their Families
news.summary: Semperis released its 2026 Ransomware Report highlighting increases in AI-driven attacks targeting identity systems, along with a rise in physical threats against executives and their families. The report covers repeat ransomware attacks, threats to employees, and attacks on identity systems outpacing organizational recovery readiness.

news.title: Workday Signs C1 Ai Deal to Govern People and Agents - El-Balad.com
news.summary: Workday signed a definitive agreement to acquire C1 AI on October 13, 2026, targeting governance of access for both human users and AI agents. The deal extends Workday's identity and access governance capabilities into the AI agent space.

news.title: Zero-Days Lurk in Microsoft's Overgrown October Patch Tuesday
news.summary: Microsoft's October Patch Tuesday, described as the largest security update ever, contains multiple zero-day vulnerabilities including security bypasses and unauthenticated remote code execution flaws. The update includes critical fixes relevant to IAM professionals managing Microsoft environments, particularly around authentication and access controls.

news.title: Attacker Chains Three Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Days for Root Access, Only Two Patched So Far
news.summary: An attacker chained three zero-day vulnerabilities in Ivanti Connect Secure VPN appliances to gain unauthenticated root access, according to security firm Volexity. Ivanti has patched two of the three flaws and is urging customers on affected versions to act immediately, while a fix for the third vulnerability remains pending.

news.title: GitHub Tightens npm Publishing After Flaw Left 1,500+ Packages Vulnerable to Hijacking
news.summary: GitHub has implemented a security change to npm's trusted publishing system, expiring unvalidated configurations 48 hours after creation following a flaw that allowed attackers to push malicious versions of other users' packages without credential theft. The vulnerability affected over 1,500 packages and exploited the trusted publishing workflow, which is used as an authentication mechanism for npm package publishing.

news.title: [Webinar] How to Stop AI-Driven Privilege Escalation With Runtime Identity Controls
news.summary: A webinar is being promoted focused on stopping AI-driven privilege escalation using runtime identity controls. The content addresses how attackers use AI to accelerate reconnaissance and privilege escalation after an initial account compromise.

news.title: No Identity, No Recovery: Cyber Resilience Starts With IAM
news.summary: The article argues that cyber resilience strategies must prioritize identity and access management due to the proliferation of enterprise applications and cloud identity providers. It calls for a rethink of identity security approaches in modern enterprise environments.

news.title: Quantum-resistant signing on AWS, Part 2: Enforce your ML-DSA algorithm policy with SCPs and IAM
news.summary: AWS published a technical guide on enforcing quantum-resistant ML-DSA cryptographic algorithm policies using Service Control Policies (SCPs) and IAM in AWS environments. The post addresses post-quantum cryptography adoption by showing how IAM policies can be used to restrict non-compliant algorithm choices across an AWS environment.

news.title: Anugal Brings Agentic AI Into Enterprise Identity Governance and Access Decisions
news.summary: Anugal has launched an agentic AI platform targeting enterprise identity governance and access decisions, including AI-assisted SAP role design, intelligent access reviews, and Microsoft Teams integration. The product aims to help enterprises make faster, risk-aware, and policy-governed access decisions through AI automation.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch update addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. The scale of the patch batch is straining organizations' ability to test and prioritize fixes, with AI being credited for accelerating vulnerability discovery.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, with evidence pointing to a Louisiana-based identity verification company as the source of the breach. The FBI's New Orleans field office has launched a formal inquiry into the origin of the leaked images.
